slug: 2026-03-16 Digital IDs How registration is progressing so far

facts.fact: The New Times reports that under the Single Digital Identification Law citizens cannot hold two government-issued identities and all current ID cards become invalid by June 2027 under the law's sunset provision; the law is described as operating, an ordinary law (no number or year given); no date for the statement beyond the article's publication date, 2026-03-16.

The article ties the Single Digital Identification Law to the digital national ID (fingerprint, facial and iris biometrics; an ID number, digital token or QR card), enrolled by NIDA; as_of is the article's publication date, 2026-03-16.
